name: wso2-api-catalogue-demo
description: End-to-end demo for WSO2 API Manager + WSO2 Integrator API catalogue modernization.

scripts.platform:import:all: docker-compose --profile platform run --rm -e APIM_ALLOW_INSECURE_TLS=true apictl "bash pipeline/scripts/deploy-all-to-apim.sh"
scripts.platform:reconcile-once: npm run platform:reconcile:core && docker-compose --profile platform up -d --force-recreate wso2-integrator ui-platform
scripts.platform:onboard: npm run platform:import:all && npm run platform:post-onboard:all && npm run platform:reconcile-once
scripts.platform:onboard:initial3: npm run platform:import:initial3 && npm run platform:post-onboard:initial3 && npm run platform:reconcile-once
scripts.platform:onboard:cards: npm run platform:import:cards && npm run platform:post-onboard:cards && npm run platform:reconcile-once
scripts.platform:onboard:loans: npm run platform:import:loans && npm run platform:post-onboard:loans && npm run platform:reconcile-once
scripts.platform:watch-sync: echo 'Do not use platform:watch-sync during tier timing tests. Use platform:onboard:* or platform:reconcile-once instead.'
scripts.platform:governance:dry-run:accounts: docker-compose --profile platform run --rm -e APIM_ALLOW_INSECURE_TLS=true apictl "bash pipeline/scripts/apictl-governance-dry-run.sh apictl/apis/accounts-api"
scripts.platform:service-catalog:logs: docker compose --profile platform logs -f wso2-integrator | grep -iE 'service catalog|Successfully updated|Customer360|ERROR|WARN'
scripts.platform:service-catalog:restart-mi: docker compose --profile platform restart wso2-integrator && docker compose --profile platform logs -f wso2-integrator
scripts.platform:payload-overrides:reset: rm -f .runtime/health-payload-overrides.json && echo "Local health payload overrides cleared."
scripts.platform:reconcile:core: docker-compose --profile platform run --rm -e APIM_ALLOW_INSECURE_TLS=true -e APIM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_BASE_URL=http://wso2-apim:8280 -e APIM_GATEWAY_BROWSER_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8280 apictl "npm run platform:reconcile:container"
scripts.platform:status:apis: curl -s http://localhost:8290/catalogue-status/v1/apis | jq '[.[] | {name, consumerStatus, invocationMode, httpStatus: .liveness.httpStatus, contract: .contract.status}]'
scripts.platform:gateway-token:reset: rm -f .runtime/api-catalogue-gateway-token.json && echo 'Gateway runtime token cache cleared.'
scripts.platform:onboard:fresh: npm run platform:gateway-token:reset && npm run platform:onboard
scripts.platform:post-onboard: npm run platform:reconcile-once && sleep 25 && npm run platform:probe
